title: Funding/volatility crowding states vs subsequent BTC/ETH spot, perp, and cash-and-carry outcomes
embargo_note: 2025-01-01..2026-07-31 treated as historical_confirmation per quant-trading/explorations/protocol-amendment.json; never accessed in wave one. Genuine untouched evidence begins with the prospective 2026-08-29 forward shadow.

mechanism.tested_thesis: Extreme point-in-time funding-percentile states (crowding) and high realized-volatility states forecast negative subsequent cash-and-carry (carry unwinding) and/or negative directional returns for BTC/ETH; a small-capacity state overlay would improve unconditional carry, or a perp directional signal would trade the unwinding.
mechanism.what_the_data_showed: The opposite sign on the tested horizons. After f_pctl>=0.99 (n=69 pooled dev decisions), subsequent 8h cash-and-carry strip mean was +4.36 bps (95% CI +1.49..+7.24 bps), Welch t vs the 15-85 mid bucket +2.68 (BTC-only +3.42, ETH-only +1.29, sign-consistent). Over 24h the effect strengthens: +14.2 bps, t=+6.77, CI +10.9..+17.6 bps. Mechanically, funding is highly persistent at 8-24h horizons: extreme funding states keep paying the long-carry side, and unfounded crash/reversion in spot or perp does not appear (8h spot t vs mid +0.92; 24h spot t -0.09..+0.14, all CIs straddle zero). Low-funding states (f_pctl<=0.15, n=382) show NEGATIVE subsequent carry (-5.29 bps 8h, t=-4.60), again opposite to the predeclared long-carry-in-quiet-crowding overlay.
mechanism.conclusion: No predeclared crowding-risk-off carry overlay produced a positive, sign-stable, symbol-consistent conditional edge on development data. All 8 predeclared variants failed their first falsification gates; nothing was selected; no frozen validation comparison of a selected variant exists. The family is falsified as specified. The 24h funding-persistence observation belongs to the long-carry side and is effectively an unconditional-carry improvement, which is an explicit non-goal of this task.

unused_by_design: okx_ETH-USDT-SWAP_latest_100.json (100-row proxy sample, handled as untrusted non-overlapping grid)

parameters.decision_grid: non-overlapping 8h: hourly bar closing at 00/08/16 UTC
parameters.funding_state: 8h-equivalent funding rate (last rate scaled by 8/interval), percentile among trailing-365d funding events strictly at/before the decision-bar close
parameters.vol_state: stdev of the last 168 hourly spot returns, percentile among trailing-365d hourly rv readings at the decision-bar close

positions.carry_variants: -1 short carry strip (long spot + short perp), +1 long strip, 0 flat

parameters.execution: position set at decision-bar close applies to the next 8 hourly bars (next-bar); cost per unit position change = one-way spot fee + one-way perp fee for carry variants, one-way perp fee for the directional variant

signal_timing.decision_instant: bar close t_c = bar_open + 1h for bars opening at 23/07/15 UTC
signal_timing.information_set: funding events with calc_time <= t_c; hourly returns of bars strictly ending at/before t_c; nothing later enters the state
signal_timing.first_position_bar: the hour after t_c (no same-bar execution)
signal_timing.outcome_windows: subsequent 8h and (second) 24h cumulative spot, perp, and stripped-carry returns

cost_model.application: cost = |position change| x unit cost, charged on the bar where the change occurs; dry-run only, no live orders
cost_model.note: Contract-conservative combined taker+slippage assumptions, not a claim about any fee tier.

benchmark.carry_variants: UNCOND-CARRY: always-on equal-weight BTC/ETH long cash-and-carry strip (spot long, perp short, collect funding), zero rebalancing turnover

validation.frozen_selected_comparison: none — no variant selected on development data, so per protocol no validation selection was frozen

exhibit_only_flagship_V1_vs_UNCOND_CARRY.note: exhibit of the REJECTED flagship; not a selected-strategy comparison and not used for any selection

first_falsification_gate.definition: Predeclared per-variant leg gate on pooled development events: conditional n >= leg-specific minimum (50-300), Welch t vs 15-85 mid bucket beyond +/-3.0 in the predeclared direction, 95% CI of the mean difference excluding zero on the predeclared side, and sign-consistency of t in both BTC and ETH (|t|>0 with matching sign). Carry-leg outcomes measured on subsequent 8h stripped carry; the directional variant on subsequent 8h perp return. V6 (drawdown-stop, unconditional) required >=50 stop events. Selection: first variant in predeclared priority order [V2,V3,V7,V4,V1,V8,V5,V6] passing its gate with dev net Sharpe > named benchmark dev Sharpe and dev cum net >= 0; frozen before any window beyond development was read.
first_falsification_gate.budget: 8 variants, run once; no thresholds, windows, or universes were retuned after seeing results.

gate_result: fail — 0/8 variants passed. V1 t=+2.68 (wrong sign, n=69<80); V2 t=+2.43 (wrong sign, n=61<80); V3 n=12<60; V7 t=+1.96; V4 t=+1.61; V8 t=+0.96; V5 n=6<60 unstable sign; V6 11 stop events<50. Selection=null; family falsified (thesis sign inverted on 8-24h horizons; spot/perp directional tails indistinguishable from zero).

leakage_checks.point_in_time_states: pass — states use funding events with calc_time <= decision close and returns of bars ending at/before it; TrailingRank is strictly trailing (unit-tested in --self-check)
leakage_checks.next_bar_execution: pass — position scheduled at decision close applies from the following hourly bar; outcome windows start at bar j+1
leakage_checks.no_holdout_access: pass — archive loader whitelists months <= 202412 regardless of flags; --end > 2024-12-31 exits with code 2 unless QUANT_HOLDOUT_UNLOCK=1 which was never set; holdout_accessed=false
leakage_checks.archive_whitelist_ceiling: pass — CLAMP_YM=202412 hard ceiling in code
leakage_checks.determinism: pass — pure-python stdlib, no randomness in the pipeline, self-check TrailingRank + rule spot checks PASS
leakage_checks.selection_independence: pass — gates, priority order, benchmarks, and cost model frozen in code before any post-2023 data was read during this run

risks: ETH tail cells underpowered (n~29-30, t 1.2-1.6); pooled n=69 for the p99 tail is small — one 2021 funding-regime episode dominates several cells
24h carry effect is substantially mechanical funding persistence; calling it tradable alpha would be double-counting what unconditional carry already earns
single-venue funding definition (Binance USD-M); OKX proxy file deliberately not integrated (non-overlapping timestamp grid)
mid-bucket overlap induces mild dependence in Welch comparisons; conclusions rest on sign and magnitude, not exact p-values
2x-cost stress applies to the exhibit only since no strategy was selected; all rejected variants already have negative dev net Sharpe at 1x costs
next_experiment: None within this family. The only sign-consistent, statistically meaningful conditional structure found (long-carry strip over-earns after extreme positive funding at 8-24h) is a persistence property of unconditional carry and is an explicit non-goal here. Recommended disposition: archive funding-crowding as falsified; if a sibling family sees the same persistence signature, it belongs in the unconditional-carry workplan as a sizing question, not as a new conditional overlay.
